nodes.label: Philocontext
nodes.rationale: Upload philosophy PDF → get rich context (metadata, historical background, study guide)

nodes.label: Client/Server Architecture
nodes.rationale: client/ (React+Vite port 5173), server/ (FastAPI port 8000)

nodes.label: Agent Skills System
nodes.rationale: CLAUDE.md defines issue tracker, triage labels, domain docs, and graphify integration for agent sessions

nodes.label: Graphify CLI Integration
nodes.rationale: Project has knowledge graph at graphify-out/; use graphify query before raw browsing

nodes.label: Graphify Usage Rules
nodes.rationale: Prefer graphify query/path/explain over raw grep; dirty graph files expected; use wiki/index.md for broad navigation; run graphify update after code changes

nodes.label: Graphify
nodes.rationale: Turns any folder into a navigable knowledge graph with community detection, audit trail, and HTML/JSON/report outputs

nodes.label: Knowledge Graph
nodes.rationale: Persistent across sessions, queryable via graphify query, built from code/docs/papers/images/video

nodes.label: Community Detection
nodes.rationale: Surfaces cross-document connections; uses clustering algorithm on constructed graph

nodes.label: Audit Trail
nodes.rationale: Three-level confidence: EXTRACTED (explicit), INFERRED (reasonable), AMBIGUOUS (uncertain). Never invent an edge.

nodes.label: Semantic Extraction
nodes.rationale: LLM-based extraction for docs/papers/images. Uses Gemini if key set, otherwise host agent. Parallel subagents per chunk.

nodes.label: AST Extraction
nodes.rationale: Deterministic structural extraction for code files. No LLM, no API key needed. Runs in parallel with semantic extraction.

nodes.label: Honesty Rules
nodes.rationale: Never invent an edge; never skip corpus check warning; always show token cost; show raw cohesion scores; warn before >5000 node viz

nodes.label: Fast Path Query
nodes.rationale: If graphify-out/graph.json exists and user asks a codebase question, skip rebuild and run graphify query immediately

nodes.label: Graphify Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Step 0-9: install check → detect files → transcribe video → extract (AST + semantic) → merge → build/cluster → health check → label → export → manifest/cleanup

nodes.label: No API Key Required
nodes.rationale: graphify never asks for API keys. Code-only corpora use AST only; semantic uses host agent or Gemini if key is set. Never blocks on missing key.

nodes.label: Node ID Format Rules
nodes.rationale: {stem}_{entity} where stem is full repo-relative path with extension dropped, segments joined by _. Lowercase, a-z0-9_ only. Deterministic from label alone.

nodes.label: Confidence Rubric
nodes.rationale: Discrete values: EXTRACTED=1.0; INFERRED from set {0.95,0.85,0.75,0.65,0.55}; AMBIGUOUS=0.1-0.3. Never use 0.5 default.

nodes.label: Hyperedges
nodes.rationale: Group 3+ nodes in shared concept/flow/pattern not captured by pairwise edges. Max 3 per chunk.

nodes.label: Incremental Update
nodes.rationale: Re-extracts only new/changed files. Code-only changes skip semantic. Uses build_merge with replace-on-re-extract. Prunes deleted files.

nodes.label: BFS/DFS Traversal
nodes.rationale: BFS for broad context (nearest neighbors), DFS for specific path tracing. Depth-limited. Token-budget aware output.

nodes.label: Query Vocabulary Expansion
nodes.rationale: Extract vocab from graph node labels, pick up to 12 matching tokens, use expanded string for traversal. No invented tokens.

nodes.label: Work Memory System
nodes.rationale: save-result with outcome (useful/dead_end/corrected) persists lessons. reflect refreshes LESSONS.md. Self-improving loop across sessions.

nodes.label: Post-Commit Hook
nodes.rationale: Auto-rebuilds graph after git commit. Only AST for code changes; doc/image changes need manual --update. Appends to existing hooks.

nodes.label: MCP Server
nodes.rationale: Stdio MCP server exposing query_graph, get_node, get_neighbors, get_community, god_nodes, graph_stats, shortest_path tools

nodes.label: Watch Mode
nodes.rationale: Background folder watcher with 3s debounce. Code-only changes trigger auto-rebuild; doc/image changes set needs_update flag.

nodes.label: GitHub Clone Flow
nodes.rationale: Clones repos into ~/.graphify/repos/, supports single repo, cross-repo merge, and monorepo multi-subfolder merge

nodes.label: Improve Historical Context & Study Guide Plan
nodes.rationale: 10-step plan to ground historical context and study guide in source text, return structured JSON, and build rich UI components
nodes.norm_label: improve historical context & study guide plan

nodes.label: HistoricalContext Model
nodes.rationale: Pydantic model with sections (title/content/source_quotes) and optional timeline. Replaces plain str field in AnalysisResult.

nodes.label: StudyGuide Model
nodes.rationale: Pydantic model with concepts (ConceptGuide: concept/definition/stakes/exam_trap/source_quotes). Replaces plain str in AnalysisResult.

nodes.label: HistoryAgent
nodes.rationale: LLM agent that generates HistoricalContext from metadata and raw_text using json_mode=True. Falls back to flat analysis on parse failure.

nodes.label: ExamAgent
nodes.rationale: LLM agent that generates StudyGuide from metadata, concepts, and raw_text using json_mode=True. Falls back to single concept on parse failure.
